summary.text: Blay Tarnoff, a Libertarian Party candidate who chairs the Nassau County Libertarian Party, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in New York's 4th Congressional District to Laura Gillen.
He has worked as a computer systems analyst and holds a law degree.
In his Ballotpedia survey he described himself as not a professional politician and said he opposed socialism.

paragraphs.text: Tarnoff graduated from The American School of Paris, according to his Ballotpedia survey.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Brown University in 1980 (an A.B. in mathematics, per the Libertarian Party of New York) and a J.D. from Pace University School of Law in 1996.

According to the Libertarian Party of New York, Tarnoff spent his career as a computer systems analyst, most recently providing technical support for quantitative financial analysts on Wall Street and developing neural network systems, and he presented at NVIDIA GPU Technology Conferences.
He has been a Libertarian activist and party representative since 1990, and he currently chairs the Nassau County Libertarian Party and the Libertarian National Judicial Committee.
He received 0.2% of the vote to Laura Gillen's 56.2%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
